messages: Hi, I saw your game profile.
Which school do you go to?
My school has a big playground.
explain: Your school name is personal information. Do not share it with an unknown person.

messages: You can tell a trusted adult if a chat worries you.
Let’s keep our chats secret from your family.
A safe friend does not ask for secrets that feel worrying.
explain: A request for a worrying secret is a red flag. Stop replying and tell a trusted adult.

messages: You do not need to send pictures to prove friendship.
Send me a photo, and do not tell anyone.
You can block or report an account that makes you uncomfortable.
explain: Never send photos to an unknown person. Save the message if safe and tell a trusted adult.

messages: Meeting an online stranger is not safe.
Let’s meet near your bus stop after school.
A trusted adult can help you report this chat.
explain: Do not meet an unknown online person. Tell a trusted adult right away.
